description: This file defines the EntityCache class, which manages caching of GenericValue objects keyed by GenericPK within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, inserting, and removing cache entries, and interacts with other utility classes and models.

classes.name: EntityCache
classes.description: A cache management class for entity data, providing methods to get, put, and remove cached GenericValue objects based on their primary keys within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: EntityCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue from the cache using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a GenericValue into the cache, using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a GenericValue into the cache with a specified primary key, respecting the entity's never-cache setting.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes entries from the cache that match a given entity condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific GenericValue from the cache based on its primary key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a GenericValue from the cache based on the entity object.
